message.content: The fixed exhaustive sweeps decisively confirm all three in-scope claims (c1: 3.31e-6 max error in the middle interval, 1174 violations; c2: 3.26e-6 in the upper interval, 1630 violations; c3: 5.03e-6 in the low region, 2802 violations — all exceeding the contract's 1e-6 absolute tolerance, with signed zeros handled correctly). Together the three sweeps cover every finite FP16 value exhaustively, so no untested accuracy surface remains. This is the final review round; no new material, testable, in-scope problem is exposed that the confirmed claims do not already cover.
